heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Management plan
tree.text: The term “management plan” means the management plan for the Scenic Area developed under section 460ffff–2(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Map
tree.text: The term “Map” means the map entitled “Proposed Alabama Hills National Scenic Area” and dated November 7, 2018.

tree.heading: Motorized vehicle
tree.text: The term “motorized vehicle” means a motorized or mechanized vehicle and includes, when used by a utility, mechanized equipment, a helicopter, and any other aerial device necessary to maintain electrical or communications infrastructure.

tree.heading: Scenic area
tree.text: The term “Scenic Area” means the Alabama Hills National Scenic Area established by section 460ffff–1(a) of this title.

tree.heading: State
tree.text: The term “State” means the State of California.

tree.heading: Tribe
tree.text: The term “Tribe” means the Lone Pine Paiute-Shoshone Tribe.
